name: 12-Ptolemaic (pure fifths and thirds: 5-Limit JI)
description: 12-tone 5-Limit Rational Intonation scale, derived from harmonic partial row intervals up to a prime limit of 5. The three major and minor triads on F, C, and G are tuned pure, as 4:5:6 or 10:12:15 ratios. The fifth between D (from the triad G major) and A (from the triad F major) is 27:40, one Syntonic Comma (81/80) smaller than a pure 2:3 ratio.
